# Tools Reference

<!-- DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY. Generated by scripts/build-docs-reference.mjs from packages/contracts/src/tool-schemas.ts -->


Cloud Harness MCP exposes **107 tools** across six operational domains. Every tool executes strictly inside a sandboxed, TTL-limited Docker container with non-root privileges and default network isolation.

## Security & Capability Badges

- <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span>: Tool inspects state without mutating workspace filesystem or runtime.
- <span class="badge-destructive">destructive</span>: Tool modifies files, processes, or git state.
- `idempotent`: Calling the tool repeatedly with identical inputs yields equivalent state.
- <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>: Tool may interact with network or long-running execution boundaries.

---

## Workspace Lifecycle

Tools for opening, inspecting, listing, secrets discovery, and closing isolated TTL-bound workspaces.

### `workspace_open`

**Open workspace**

Clone an approved HTTPS repository and start an owner-bound, TTL-limited coding workspace. The result hardExpiresAt is a fixed deadline set by the instance maximum workspace lifetime that no renewal or activity extends.

**Attributes:** `idempotent` · <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>

|---|---|---|---|
| `repositoryUrl` | `string` | **Yes** | format: `uri` |
| `ref` | `string` | No | length: 1–255 |
| `idempotencyKey` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`, length: 8–128 |
| `fetchDepth` | `integer` | No | Commits of history to clone; 0 clones full history. Omitted keeps the default single-commit clone. (range: 0–100000) |
| `shallowSince` | string \| string | No | Clone history newer than this ISO date or datetime instead of a commit count. |
| `networkProfile` | `"network-none"` \| `"dependency-access"` | No | — |

### `bash`

**Run bash command**

Run one bounded bash command. target "workspace" (default) uses the exec_run path in the workspace executor. target "toolbox" runs in a disposable no-network container with no workspace checkout, no secrets, and no workspaceId; it is available only when the operator enables packages. Both targets accept async: true for an operation handle. bash has no privileged mode: use exec_run with its approval flow for privileged commands.

## Managed Packages

Plan, approve, apply, inspect, roll back, and uninstall pinned CLI packages kept across workspaces and redeploys (off unless the operator enables managed packages).

### `packages_plan`

**Plan managed package change**

Resolve one managed toolbox package change into an immutable plan without installing anything and without running package code (uv accepts wheels only; npm lifecycle scripts stay off unless allowed). ecosystem "npm" or "uv" (uv tools get their own managed Python); "apt" is not supported and returns NOT_SUPPORTED because system packages need a reviewed executor image variant. scope "owner" (default) makes the tool available to all your new workspaces and the bash toolbox target; scope "workspace" needs workspaceId and overrides the owner binding there. "instance" scope does not exist. If resolution is still running after about 20 seconds, the result is { resolutionId, state: "RESOLVING" } instead: poll packages_status with that resolutionId (and waitMs) until it is READY with the plan or FAILED. The plan lists the exact version, source, integrity, dependency count, size, binaries, conflicts, affected workspaces, and planDigest. approval "required" means an operator approves the plan in the Dashboard first; "unavailable" means this instance cannot approve plans. Use for durable CLI tools; use npm install or uv in a workspace for project dependencies. Off unless the operator sets PACKAGES_ENABLED=true.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ecosystem` | `"npm"` \| `"uv"` \| `"apt"` | **Yes** | — |
| `name` | `string` | **Yes** | length: 1–214 |
| `version` | `string` | No | length: 1–128 |
| `scope` | `"owner"` \| `"workspace"` | No | default: `"owner"` |
| `workspaceId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^ws_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `python` | `string` | No | pattern: `^3\.\d{1,2}(\.\d{1,2})?$` |
| `lifecycleScripts` | `boolean` | No | — |

### `packages_apply`

**Apply managed package plan**

Build an approved plan (planId with the exact planDigest from packages_plan) into an immutable release in an isolated builder, verify its file tree, and launch-check every binary without network. Returns an applyId immediately; poll packages_status with applyId. Replaying the same plan returns the same apply. A release is installed only when the apply reaches SUCCEEDED. Existing workspaces keep their mounted releases until they are recreated; new workspaces and the bash toolbox target use the new release.

**Attributes:** `idempotent` · <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `planId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^pkp_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `planDigest` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[a-f0-9]{64}$` |

### `packages_list`

**List managed packages**

List managed package bindings (what each scope uses now) and verified releases, with versions, digests, sizes, binaries, and whether a release was built for an older executor image (stale). Set includeHistory to see earlier releases you can roll back to.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span> · `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `"owner"` \| `"workspace"` | No | — |
| `workspaceId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^ws_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |

### `packages_status`

**Managed package status**

Read a managed package apply by applyId (state, error code, bounded output tail, release id) or a plan resolution by resolutionId (RESOLVING, READY with the plan, or FAILED with its error), optionally waiting up to waitMs for it to change. Without either, summarize in-flight applies, plans waiting for approval, missing releases, and workspaces that need recreation to pick up a change.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span> · `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `applyId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^pka_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `resolutionId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^pkq_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `waitMs` | `integer` | No | range: 0–30000, default: `0` |

### `packages_rollback`

**Roll back managed package**

Point a managed package binding back to an earlier verified release from its history. Needs bindingId, releaseId, and the binding generation you last read (expectedGeneration); a moved generation returns STALE_GENERATION. Needs no new approval. Workspaces pick up the change when recreated.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-destructive">destructive</span> · `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bindingId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^pkb_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `releaseId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^pkr_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `expectedGeneration` | `integer` | **Yes** | range: 0–9007199254740991 |

### `packages_remove`

**Uninstall managed package**

Uninstall a managed package from one scope: deletes the binding (bindingId from packages_list, with its current generation as expectedGeneration) and its rollback history, and collects releases no retained workspace still mounts. A moved generation returns STALE_GENERATION; a running apply returns CONFLICT. Needs no approval. New workspaces and the bash toolbox stop seeing the tool at once; existing workspaces keep it until recreated. Reinstalling needs a new plan.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-destructive">destructive</span>

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bindingId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^pkb_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `expectedGeneration` | `integer` | **Yes** | range: 0–9007199254740991 |

### `github_action`

**Create and manage GitHub issues, pull requests, native PR reviews, review threads, reviewers, merges, commit statuses, and Actions workflow runs**

Create GitHub issues (action: "issue_create"), list, view, comment on, update, and publish issues, manage labels, and list, view, create, update, comment on, review (native COMMENT/APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES reviews, inline file/line comments, review-thread reply/resolve/unresolve), assign reviewers, toggle draft/ready, merge, and auto-merge pull requests; create commit statuses on a SHA (commit_status_create: state, context, description, targetUrl); dispatch a workflow on a ref with inputs (workflow_dispatch) and re-run only the failed jobs of a run (workflow_run_rerun_failed), in the repository bound to an owner-authorized workspace. Maps to advertised capabilities like operations.issueCreate, issueComment, pullRequestCreate, pullRequestReview, pullRequestMerge, commitStatusCreate, workflowDispatch, and workflowRunRerun; workspace_capabilities.githubActions is the authoritative action list. Supported actions: issue_create, issue_list, issue_view, issue_comment, issue_comment_update, issue_update, issue_publish, label_create, issue_labels_add, issue_labels_remove, pr_list, pr_view, pr_reviews, pr_review_threads, pr_create, pr_update, pr_comment, pr_review, pr_review_comment, pr_review_reply, pr_review_thread_resolve, pr_review_thread_unresolve, pr_reviewers_request, pr_reviewers_remove, pr_ready, pr_convert_to_draft, pr_merge, pr_auto_merge_enable, pr_auto_merge_disable, commit_status_create, workflow_dispatch, workflow_run_rerun_failed, commit_list, compare, release_list, tag_list, ref_get, commit_status_get, check_runs_list, workflow_runs_list, workflow_run_view. Writes that can duplicate a side effect accept an idempotencyKey. Prefer github_read for read-only actions: this tool is annotated destructive, so clients may ask for approval on every call. Atomic ref creation, compare-and-swap, and delete-if-match go through git_push leases, not this tool. Uses broker-managed GitHub App credentials via an ephemeral helper; GitHub tokens are never exposed to the workspace.

## Models and Spend

Choose a provider and model, check a connection, save agent model profiles (created disabled; the owner activates them on the Dashboard), and read estimated model spend. Keys, activation, deletion, and spend policies stay on the Dashboard.

### `model_provider_list`

**List model providers**

List the supported model providers (auth header modes, API modes and endpoints, catalog source) and your connected provider credentials as metadata (id, provider, status, key version, last check). Keys are never returned, and no tool creates, rotates, or reads one: the owner adds keys on the Dashboard. Optional provider narrows both lists.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span> · `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `"openai"` \| `"anthropic"` \| `"openrouter"` \| `"google"` \| `"deepseek"` \| `"custom"` | No | — |

### `model_catalog_search`

**Search model catalog**

Search the cached model catalog for one provider, optionally through your credential's models listing (credentialId). Prices are integer micro-USD per million tokens and are estimates; null means unknown, not free. A cold or stale cache may be filled from the provider, so the call can be slow. When saving a profile, use an entry's providerModelId as model and its pricing.provenance.sourceModelId as catalogPriceRef.sourceModelId to pin catalog-verified prices.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span> · `idempotent` · <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `"openai"` \| `"anthropic"` \| `"openrouter"` \| `"google"` \| `"deepseek"` \| `"custom"` | **Yes** | — |
| `credentialId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^cred_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `query` | `string` | No | max length: 200 |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | length: 1–256 |
| `limit` | `integer` | No | range: 1–100, default: `25` |
| `capability` | `"tools"` \| `"reasoning"` \| `"vision"` | No | — |

### `model_connection_verify`

**Check model connection**

Check a saved profile (profileId) or a draft route on a stored credential (credentialId with model, apiMode, and customUpstreamUrl for a Custom credential) with bounded probes: authentication, model access, streaming inference, and an opt-in tool call. It spends a few tokens, shares the per-principal rate limit with the Dashboard, and is audited. A draft that names a model returns verificationRef; pass it to model_profile_validate and model_profile_create or model_profile_update with the same route to keep the result. Over MCP, a custom upstream URL must already be used by one of your profiles on that credential, else OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-openworld">openWorld</span>

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credentialId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^cred_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `model` | `string` | No | length: 1–100 |
| `apiMode` | `"chat-completions"` \| `"responses"` | No | — |
| `customUpstreamUrl` | `string` | No | format: `uri`, max length: 1024 |
| `checks` | `object` | No | — |
| `profileId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, length: 1–80 |

### `model_profile_list`

**List agent model profiles**

List your agent model profiles with status, generation (pass it as expectedGeneration to model_profile_update), active revision, pinned prices, limits, last connection check, and a repricing review against the cached catalog. Optional profileId narrows the list to one profile.

**Attributes:** <span class="badge-ro">readOnly</span> · `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, length: 1–80 |

### `model_profile_validate`

**Dry-run agent model profile change**

Dry-run a profile create (action "create" with the model_profile_create fields) or update (action "update" with profileId, expectedGeneration, and the changed fields). It returns the revision a save would write, issues, a pricing review, whether verificationRef would attach, and escalations: changes that need owner approval on the Dashboard and that model_profile_create or model_profile_update would refuse with OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. It writes nothing.

| `profileId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, length: 1–80 |
| `displayName` | `string` | No | length: 1–100 |
| `credentialId` | `string` | No | pattern: `^cred_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `model` | `string` | No | length: 1–100 |

### `model_profile_create`

**Create agent model profile**

Create an agent model profile on one of your stored credentials. Profiles created over MCP start DISABLED: the owner activates them on the Dashboard before agent_spawn can use them. Needs an idempotencyKey; replaying the same key and input returns the first result with replayed true, and the same key with other input returns CONFLICT. A custom upstream URL that none of your profiles on that credential uses returns OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED and creates nothing.

**Attributes:** `idempotent`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, length: 1–80 |
| `displayName` | `string` | **Yes** | length: 1–100 |
| `credentialId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^cred_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `model` | `string` | **Yes** | length: 1–100 |
| `apiMode` | `"chat-completions"` \| `"responses"` | **Yes** | — |
| `customUpstreamUrl` | `string` | No | format: `uri`, max length: 1024 |
| `pricing` | `object` | **Yes** | — |
| `limits` | `object` | **Yes** | — |
| `maxProxyOperations` | string[] | **Yes** | — |
| `verificationRef` | `string` | No | pattern: `^vref_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `catalogPriceRef` | `object` | No | — |
| `idempotencyKey` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`, length: 8–128 |

### `model_profile_update`

**Update agent model profile**

Create a new revision of one of your profiles, guarded by expectedGeneration (a moved generation returns CONFLICT: re-read it with model_profile_list) and an idempotencyKey. Omitted fields keep their current values. Moving to another credentialId, raising a limit, lowering a price that is not catalog-verified, carrying override prices to another model or credential, widening proxy operations, or using an unbound custom upstream returns OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED and changes nothing, whatever the profile status; the owner makes those changes on the Dashboard. Status is never changed here.

| `model` | `string` | No | length: 1–100 |
| `apiMode` | `"chat-completions"` \| `"responses"` | No | — |
| `customUpstreamUrl` | `string` | No | format: `uri`, max length: 1024 |
| `pricing` | `object` | No | — |
| `limits` | `object` | No | — |
| `maxProxyOperations` | string[] | No | — |
| `expectedGeneration` | `integer` | **Yes** | range: 0–9007199254740991 |
| `verificationRef` | `string` | No | pattern: `^vref_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,80}$` |
| `catalogPriceRef` | `object` | No | — |
| `profileId` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, length: 1–80 |
| `idempotencyKey` | `string` | **Yes** | pattern: `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`, length: 8–128 |

### `model_spend_summary`

**Read estimated model spend**

Read your estimated model spend for the current UTC day and month windows (settled, reserved by open runs, and unreconciled), and the owner-set spend policies that bound it. Read-only. Figures are gateway-side estimates from pinned profile prices, not provider invoices. Spend policies are changed only on the Dashboard. Optional period narrows windows and policies to "day" or "month".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | `"day"` \| `"month"` | No | — |

### `github_read`

**Read GitHub pull requests, reviews, review threads, issues, commits, comparisons, releases, tags, refs, commit statuses, check runs, and Actions workflow runs**

Read-only GitHub access for the repository bound to an owner-authorized workspace, without per-call approval prompts. Supported actions: pr_list, pr_view, pr_reviews (every review with its state and the latest state per reviewer, including CHANGES_REQUESTED), pr_review_threads (review threads with stable thread IDs), issue_list, issue_view, commit_list (history with sha, path, since, until filters), compare (base...head commits and changed files), release_list, tag_list, ref_get (current OID of refs/heads/... or refs/tags/..., or exists: false), commit_status_get (combined status and every status context for a SHA or ref), check_runs_list (check runs for a SHA or ref), workflow_runs_list (Actions runs filtered by workflow, headSha, branch, event, status), and workflow_run_view (one run with its jobs and conclusions). Maps to operations.pullRequestList, pullRequestView, pullRequestReviewList, issueList, issueView, commitList, compare, releaseList, tagList, refGet, commitStatusRead, checkRunList, and workflowRunRead. Uses broker-managed GitHub App credentials via an ephemeral helper; GitHub tokens are never exposed to the workspace.

| `limit` | `integer` | No | range: 1–250 |
